title: voynich_xc: Structural Visibility, Pharmaceutical Supply Chains, and Falsifiable Grammar Discovery in the Voynich Manuscript
description: A reproducible suite of 35 computational probes built on the XEMBRA (.xc) morpho-syntactic interpreter analyzing the 15th-century Voynich Manuscript. Compiles the 135-entry Master Voynich Codex Lexicon (voynich_master_lexicon.json and .csv) and reconstructs all 359 Starred Recipe cards (103r-116v) across all six manuscript sections.
